claims.claim: Healthline sells personal information to marketing and advertising vendors for targeted advertising.
claims.quote: Healthline “sells” or “shares” (as those terms are defined by the CCPA) the following categories of personal information to various marketing and advertising vendors for the purposes of serving you with targeted advertisements, either on behalf of us or third parties.

claims.claim: Personal information is shared with other RVO Health brands and business divisions.
claims.quote: As discussed below, you should be aware that RVO Health makes your personal information available to each of its business divisions and operating brands, including the personal information that is the subject of this Notice.

claims.claim: Healthline uses personal information for targeted advertising on third-party websites.
claims.quote: Engaging in targeted advertising on other websites or mobile applications, even if those websites or mobile applications are owned by third parties.

claims.claim: Healthline uses Google Analytics to understand website traffic and usage patterns.
claims.quote: Analytics vendors in order to understand our website traffic and usage patterns, optimize our website, track marketing conversions, and identify potential new customers or users.

claims.claim: Healthline uses cookies to recognize users, store preferences, and analyze traffic.
claims.quote: Our website uses different types of cookies to, among other things, automatically recognize you when you return to our site, store information regarding your preferences, and analyze traffic to our site.

claims.claim: Personal information is disclosed to third-party service providers, including IT, hosting, and marketing vendors.
claims.quote: We may disclose your personal information to the following types of individuals or entities: Service providers we use to facilitate our business operations and administer our services.

claims.claim: Healthline does not honor "Do Not Track" signals but recognizes Global Privacy Control.
claims.quote: Please note that our websites do not honor “Do Not Track” signals, and such signals will not impact the operation of our websites. We do recognize the Global Privacy Control.

claims.claim: Personal information is retained as long as there is a legitimate business need or as required by law.
claims.quote: Healthline will retain the personal information it collects and uses so long as it has a legitimate business need to do so, or as required by law (e.g., for tax, legal, accounting or other purposes), whichever is the longer.

report.headline: Healthline shares personal information for targeted advertising and with its parent company.
summary: Healthline explicitly states it *sells* personal data to advertising vendors.
Information is shared across all RVO Health brands (including Healthline).
While they recognize Global Privacy Control, they ignore 'Do Not Track' requests.
tips: Use a browser extension designed to block third-party tracking.
Review and adjust your cookie preferences in your browser settings.
Check Healthline's privacy policy regularly for updates.
